title: Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls. In this setting, the main challenge is to improve task performance without degrading the generalization capabilities of the model. In this paper, we present an extensive set of ablations for fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We compare three training regimes: (1) response-only LoRA, where the supervised response is the label alone; (2) single-adapter reasoning, where reasoning traces from a teacher model are included alongside the labels in the training loss; and (3) dual-adapter composite training, where separate LoRA adapters are trained on traces and labels. translated_title: LoRA领域自适应中的推理监督与能力保持
translated_abstract: 在金融数据上对基础模型进行微调具有广泛的应用，包括从新闻中识别事件类型、监控风险与合规语言，以及针对财报和业绩电话会议进行问答。在这一场景中，主要挑战是在不损害模型泛化能力的前提下提升任务性能。本文针对使用低秩适应（LoRA）微调Qwen3-8B进行了大量的消融实验，比较了三种训练方式：（1）仅响应LoRA，即监督信号仅为标签本身；（2）单适配器推理训练，即在训练损失中将来自教师模型的推理轨迹与标签一起纳入；（3）双适配器复合训练，即为推理轨迹和标签分别训练独立的LoRA适配器。结果显示，仅响应LoRA能够提升领域内性能，同时使模型的通用能力保持在与冻结模型相近的水平。领域内的变化为……
tldr: 该论文通过对Qwen3-8B进行LoRA微调的系统消融实验，比较仅响应、单适配器推理和双适配器复合三种训练方式，发现仅响应LoRA能在提升金融领域任务性能的同时保持模型的通用能力。
